list_pretrained_models: list all available pretrained CLIP model names and their pretrain tags
list_pretrained_tag_models: list all model architectures that have a given pretrain tag like openai or laion400m
list_pretrained_model_tags: list all available pretrain tags for a given model architecture like ViT-B-32
get_pretrained_url: get the download URL for a pretrained model given its architecture name and tag
download_pretrained: download a pretrained CLIP model weights file from a URL with SHA256 checksum verification
